environment: Node test runner, python3, macOS; verify worktree sdlc/S-027c-v0-contract-0 at afe9bbe

cases.title: Each section 8 row holds its mapped placeholders
cases.given: The 23 prompt files of the table on branch sdlc/S-027c
cases.when: Read each file and look for each mapped placeholder

cases.title: The six extra literals are gone and sdlc/{name} stays
cases.given: commit-state, escalator, SKILL.md, state-schema, four other prompts
cases.when: Scan for old literals and the default format text
cases.then: No old literal; default text stays in SKILL.md and state-schema.md
cases.expected: No old literal; default text stays in SKILL.md and state-schema.md
cases.actual: As expected; escalator spike phrase is present

cases.title: Independent line-based scan finds no literal
cases.when: Scan with a line parser that handles ``` and ~~~ fences, and again with no fence exemption
cases.then: No hit in either scan; sdlc/S-001 matches; .sdlc/slices, sdlc/tracker, sdlc/STOP, sdlc/{name} do not match
cases.expected: No hit in either scan; sdlc/S-001 matches; .sdlc/slices, sdlc/tracker, sdlc/STOP, sdlc/{name} do not match
cases.actual: files=55, exempt=[], bad=[], raw hits=[]. No fenced block exempts anything.

cases.title: Shipped scan helper at fence boundaries
cases.given: Fixtures with a branches.py output block plus an unfenced literal, an unclosed fence, tilde fences, an inline span and an empty text
cases.when: Run the shipped stripBranchesOutput and the pattern
cases.then: Unfenced literal fails; unclosed, tilde and inline cases fail; empty text passes
cases.expected: Unfenced literal fails; unclosed, tilde and inline cases fail; empty text passes

evidence.title: fixtures
evidence.inline: output block exempt; literal after or before it fails; plain block fails; ~~~ fails; unclosed fails; inline span fails; literal between two blocks fails

cases.title: Property: scan helper against a reference model
cases.given: Random documents of safe text, literals, branches.py blocks and plain blocks
cases.when: Compare the helper with the model (a literal outside a branches.py block must match)

cases.title: Updated assertions keep their sentences; suite runs green
cases.given: The diff of prompts.test.mjs and the repo test file
cases.when: Read the diff and run node --test skills/sdlc/test/prompts.test.mjs
cases.then: No test skipped or deleted; 91 of 91 pass
cases.expected: No test skipped or deleted; 91 of 91 pass
cases.actual: 91 of 91 pass. Each literal assertion now holds its placeholder in the same sentence. One assertion was dropped (see seeds).

seeds.title: scan helper exempts a whole fenced block that only mentions branches.py
seeds.detail: stripBranchesOutput removes any ``` block whose text contains the word branches.py. A hand-written literal inside such a block passes. Probe: a block with a branches.py line and git checkout sdlc/S-001 gives no match. The prompts have no such block today (no fenced block holds a literal). Tighten the helper to exempt only the output lines.

seeds.title: the env-detector count assertion was dropped
seeds.detail: The old test asserted 'count of `sdlc/run-*` branches) + 1' and refs/heads/sdlc/run-*. The edit replaced both with a doesNotMatch on sdlc/run-. The prompt still says '(count of branches of kind `run`) + 1', so the test no longer pins the numbering rule. Add an assertion for that sentence.

seeds.title: the spike phrase sits inside a code span
seeds.detail: escalator.md writes `a scratch branch named like <slice branch> with -spike added` in backticks, although the phrase is prose. The ADR gives the phrase without backticks. The meaning is clear.

seeds.title: the scan helper ignores tilde fences
seeds.detail: ~~~ fences are never exempt, so the scan is strict there. No prompt uses them. No action needed unless a prompt adds one.

surface: Contract surface: 54 prompt .md files plus SKILL.md. No code exports. Placeholders defined in _common.md: run, slice, milestone, e2e, e2e area, state, attempt, verify branch.
